prompt: Which uses a single listener for multiple buttons, distinguishing them by action command?
choices: ActionListener listener = e -> { if ("save".equals(e.getActionCommand())) save(); else load(); }; button1.setActionCommand("save"); button2.setActionCommand("load"); button1.addActionListener(listener); button2.addActionListener(listener);
explanation: Set distinct action commands on each button, register the same listener on both. Inside the listener, switch on e.getActionCommand() to dispatch behavior. This avoids duplicating listener code for each button.
